quarterly_data.signal: As of June 30, 2026, expected future fixed or guaranteed commitments under contracts with remaining terms greater than one year were $707.0 billion, the significant majority of which related to long-term supply agreements to secure future production capacity for technical infrastructure and inventory components; the rest covers energy service agreements to secure data center energy (terms of two to 26 years, obligations through 2054) and content licensing agreements. Commitments under the long-term supply agreements and content licenses are expected to be generally fulfilled through 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: $707.0 billion fixed or guaranteed commitments with remaining terms over one year (June 30, 2026), significant majority long-term supply agreements securing production capacity

quarterly_data.signal: Alphabet's total revenue backlog (remaining performance obligations) was $519.5 billion as of June 30, 2026; Alphabet expects to recognize just over 50% as revenue over the next 24 months. From the first quarter of 2026 the backlog also includes contracts with an original expected term of one year or less.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue backlog $519.5 billion (June 30, 2026); just over 50% over the next 24 months

quarterly_data.signal: Alphabet's inventory consists primarily of hardware related to TPU systems for sale to enterprise customers and devices (mainly Pixel); it uses third-party contract manufacturers (not named) to manufacture its inventory.
